meta.notes: Level 60 pre-raid (Pre-BIS) WoW Forever lists built by web/scripts/fetch-forever-bis.py. Each entry's "from" says which source listed it: sim (the simulator's gear set, first pick), kami (computed from the simulator's stat weights) or cwf (classicwowforever, alternatives). Every item is checked against the simulator's item database: wrong-role items and raid drops are left out. Random-suffix items keep the suffix in the name and use the base item ID.
